[39m[31m<script>[39m[31m\n
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {\n
    const sidebar = document.getElementById('sidebar');\n
    const main = document.getElementById('main-content');\n
    const toggle = document.getElementById('sidebar-toggle');\n
    const toggleIcon = toggle.querySelector('i');\n
    const toggleText = toggle.querySelector('span');\n
    const sidebarContent = document.getElementById('sidebar-content');\n
    const sections = document.querySelectorAll('.sidebar-section');\n
    \n
    // 🔧 SCROLL POSITION PERSISTENCE\n
    const savedScroll = localStorage.getItem('sidebarScroll');\n
    if (savedScroll) {\n
        sidebarContent.scrollTop = parseInt(savedScroll);\n
    }\n
    \n
    sidebarContent.addEventListener('scroll', () => {\n
        localStorage.setItem('sidebarScroll', sidebarContent.scrollTop);\n
    });\n
    \n
    // 🎯 COLLAPSE/EXPAND TOGGLE\n
    toggle.addEventListener('click', () => {\n
        sidebar.classList.toggle('collapsed');\n
        main.classList.toggle('sidebar-collapsed');\n
        \n
        if (sidebar.classList.contains('collapsed')) {\n
            toggleIcon.className = 'bi bi-arrow-bar-right';\n
            toggleText.textContent = 'Expand';\n
        } else {\n
            toggleIcon.className = 'bi bi-arrow-bar-left';\n
            toggleText.textContent = 'Collapse';\n
        }\n
    });\n
    \n
    // 📂 ACCORDION BEHAVIOR - SINGLE SECTION EXPANSION\n
    let activeSection = null;\n
    \n
    sections.forEach(section => {\n
        const header = section.querySelector('.nav-header');\n
        const collapse = section.querySelector('.nav-collapse');\n
        const links = section.querySelectorAll('.nav-link');\n
        \n
        // Check if any link in this section is active\n
        let sectionIsActive = false;\n
        links.forEach(link => {\n
            if (link.classList.contains('active')) {\n
                sectionIsActive = true;\n
            }\n
        });\n
        \n
        // Auto-expand active section\n
        if (sectionIsActive) {\n
            section.classList.add('open');\n
            activeSection = section;\n
        }\n
        \n
        // Add click handler for section header\n
        header.addEventListener('click', (e) => {\n
            e.preventDefault();\n
            \n
            // Close all other sections\n
            sections.forEach(s => {\n
                if (s !== section) {\n
                    s.classList.remove('open');\n
                }\n
            });\n
            \n
            // Toggle current section\n
            section.classList.toggle('open');\n
            activeSection = section.classList.contains('open') ? section : null;\n
        });\n
    });\n
    \n
    // 🔗 ACTIVE STATE MANAGEMENT - Route-based highlighting\n
    const currentPath = window.location.pathname;\n
    const allLinks = document.querySelectorAll('.nav-link');\n
    \n
    allLinks.forEach(link => {\n
        const href = link.getAttribute('href');\n
        if (href && currentPath.includes(href.replace('http://localhost', ''))) {\n
            link.classList.add('active');\n
            \n
            // Find parent section and expand it\n
            const parentSection = link.closest('.sidebar-section');\n
            if (parentSection) {\n
                parentSection.classList.add('open');\n
                activeSection = parentSection;\n
            }\n
        }\n
    });\n
    \n
    // 🎯 AUTO-SCROLL TO ACTIVE SECTION\n
    if (activeSection) {\n
        setTimeout(() => {\n
            const header = activeSection.querySelector('.nav-header');\n
            if (header) {\n
                header.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'nearest' });\n
            }\n
        }, 100);\n
    }\n
});\n
[39m[31m</script>[39m[31m\n
